annotation.title_clean: Commission Implementing Regulation (EU) 2021/664 of 22 April 2021 on a regulatory framework for the U-space
annotation.title_en: Commission Implementing Regulation (EU) 2021/664 of 22 April 2021 on a regulatory framework for the U-space
annotation.venue: Official Journal of the European Union, L 139
annotation.summary_en: EU Commission Implementing Regulation establishing the U-space framework for safe, automated management of drone (UAS) traffic in designated airspace. It mandates U-space services, certification of service providers, data and cybersecurity requirements, and competent authority oversight, applying from 26 January 2023.
key_provisions_or_claims: Member States designate U-space airspace based on an airspace risk assessment
Mandatory services: network identification, geo-awareness, flight authorisation, traffic information
U-space service providers must be certified by national authority or EASA, with management, security and liability arrangements
Common information services with interoperable protocols and data quality, latency and protection requirements
Excludes military/state operations, model clubs, and C0/under-250g open A1 operations
